title: CELLSTYLEMAP versioned identity domains
mode: ODA specification cross-check plus generated AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 object vectors

authoritativeReferences.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authoritativeReferences.finding: CELLSTYLEMAP uses built-in cell-style IDs 1=title, 2=header, 3=data, and R24 adds ID 4=table; custom IDs start at 101. The documented cell-style classes are 1=data and 2=label.

researchConclusion.resolved: The CELLSTYLEMAP DWG parser now validates built-in/custom identity IDs with the AC1021-to-AC1024 ID-4 version boundary and rejects IDs in the reserved range. It rejects negative or above-2 class values while preserving class 0 as opaque compatibility state, matching the existing R24 TABLESTYLE repeated-style reader behavior.
researchConclusion.unresolved: No independent CELLSTYLEMAP class-0 producer witness, owner/root serializer contract, or custom-style DXF object-graph writer was established. The adapter export gate remains fail-closed.

changes: CELLSTYLEMAP IDs 1–3 are accepted for AC1021 and later; ID 4 is accepted only for AC1024 and later; IDs 101+ are treated as custom IDs.
Negative IDs, ID 0, reserved IDs 5–100, and class values outside 0–2 refuse parsing through the existing atomic reset path.
Generated frames cover AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 with valid/invalid identity values and verify typed readback or complete reset.
